cpu.calibrated: 2026-10-06, emulator at 96 MHz, bench.c scenarios 1 2 3 7 8 (docs/CPU-GUARD.md); X0X: 2026-10-07, scenario 8 on the X0X 909 and 808 kits (x0x-drums)
cpu.rule: scale_pct: the smallest measured / predicted load over the scenarios; engine_pct: the same over the scenarios of that engine alone (FM6: 1 and 10; ACID: 7; X0X: 8 on kits 37 and 38), so the prediction stays at or under the measured load
